As a CNC operator / Machine operator you will be setting up, operating, running and maintaining computer numerical control (CNC) machines to manufacture parts according to blueprints and specifications. 

Your key responsibilities will include:

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor in Materials for Power Electronics / Printed Electronics
jobs.description:
The cross-border region Denmark-Germany is a powerhouse in industrial electronics. The Centre for Industrial Electronics (CIE) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) was established by a strong partnership between industry, academia and regional authorities. CIE is located at the campus of SDU Sønderborg and surrounded by a vibrant industrial environment. CIE is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Job description 

We are seeking an innovative and visionary Assistant Professor to join the Centre for Industrial Electronics in Sønderborg. The Centre currently has 40 staff, including full and associate professors, assistant professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, and support staff. Funding has been secured to support to establish new research and test laboratories in key areas of industrial electronics. Our ambition is to deliver excellence in research, innovation, and education.

It is our vision that the Centre for Industrial Electronics at SDU will excel in areas of key relevance for companies in the region of Southern Denmark and beyond. 

Candidates are thus required to have a proven research records at least one of the following fields:

• 
General power electronics and its reliability

• 
Multimaterial additive manufacturing

• 
Printed electronics

• 
Polymer composites and nanocomposites for energy applications

• 
Surface and interface engineering

• 
Dielectric materials and capacitor technology

• 
Materials for power electronics

• 
Energy-device manufacturing

• 
Sustainable and circular electronics

 

Qualifications

The candidates must have a PhD in Electrical Engineering/Materials science/Mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline. 

We also expect:

• 
An outstanding research and publication track record 

• 
Experience with industrial collaboration

• 
Research experience in multi-material additive manufacturing of functional polymer composites

• 
Experience developing polymer nanocomposite dielectrics and thin-film capacitors

• 
Knowledge of nanoparticle surface modification, dispersion, and interface engineering

• 
Hands-on experience in materials processing, device fabrication, and electrical characterization

• 
Ability to investigate relationships between material structure, manufacturing conditions, and electrical performance

• 
Peer-reviewed publications in functional materials, additive manufacturing, or energy-device research

• 
Experience collaborating across materials science and electrical engineering.

Further desirable qualifications:

• 
Experience with bio-based, self-healing, or temperature-resistant capacitor materials

• 
Knowledge of scalable thin-film fabrication, including layer-by-layer deposition or coating.

• 
Experience translating research into industrial applications, particularly embedded heating, sensing, or battery-conditioning systems.

• 
Experience preparing research proposals, securing research resources, and training students.

 

Contact and further information

For information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical engineering, which encompasses SDU Electrical Engineering please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

For specific information on section and centre, please visit www.sdu.dk/ee and www.sdu.dk/cie. 

You are also welcome to contact the Head of the CIE, Professor Thomas Ebel (ebel@sdu.dk,  +45 93 50 72 05) for further information. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

A panel will assess the qualification of the candidate for the described post based on the submitted material. 

The application should include:

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Motivated application. 

• 
Ideas for research and development activities.

• 
Account of significant contributions to innovation in Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering Electronics.

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant to the position. 

• 
Summary and documentation of teaching experience, including account of experience in training students and outreach. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the position is open from start of 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.occupation: Senior Contract Management Specialist (Senior Contract Counsel)
jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**The Senior Contract Management Specialist / Senior Contract Counsel (CM) is a key role in the Contract Management team, which is part of Legal & Compliance. The CM supports all SimCorp offerings, including on-premises, SaaS, Professional Services and BPaaS. The CM is responsible for drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing various contracts with clients, as well as providing legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters. The CM also ensures that the contracts are compliant with the law and the business objectives, and that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework.

The CM works closely with the Legal team, Customer Success Management, Service Delivery Management, Project Management Office, and other internal stakeholders to understand the business and technical requirements, and to align the contracts with the best practices and standards of SimCorp. The CM also collaborates with Client Services to monitor and optimize the commercial performance and quality of the contracts.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**The CM is involved in the entire contract lifecycle, from the pre-contractual phase and support to Customer Success Management, to the onboarding project, to the contract change management, to the obligation management and quality assurance, to the exit handling.

The CM also manages and maintains together with the team the contract repository and the contractual database and supports the further implementation of contract management processes and relevant tools within SimCorp, including the upcoming Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Platform.

The CM will be part of a self-organizing and cross-functional team that delivers value to the clients and the business.

As a CM, some of the daily or weekly tasks that you can expect are:

• Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing client contracts, and ensuring that they are aligned with the legal, commercial and technical requirements

• Business partnering through legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters, and resolving contract-related issues and disputes

• Supporting the Customer Success Management, the Service Delivery Managers, the Project Managers, and other internal stakeholders with contract and legal interpretations

• Monitoring and optimizing the commercial performance and quality of the contracts, and collaborating with the business on commercial management

• Supporting the obligation management and quality assurance process, and ensuring that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework

• Supporting the exit handling process, and assisting with drafting termination notices and handling contractual obligations related to the exit strategy

• Participating in weekly status meetings

• Learning and developing new skills and competencies related to contract management and legal matters

**What We Value

**

• A law degree or a relevant degree in contract management, contract administration, or business administration, with a focus on commercial law

• 5+ years of experience in contract management, contract administration, or as a legal counsel, preferably in the SaaS, Outsourcing or IT industry

• Knowledge of contract and commercial law, as well as the legal and regulatory aspects of SaaS and cloud services

• Knowledge of Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) is an advantage

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Co-Pilot/Claude, and in contract management software and tools

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken

• Experience working in a collaborative team that values teamwork, humor, and good communication

• The CM is expected to have solid communication and presentation skills, as well as solid analytical and problem-solving abilities. The CM should be able to work on their own initiative and as part of a team, and to handle multiple tasks and projects in a fast-paced and demanding environment. The CM should also have a high level of professionalism and integrity, and a customer-oriented and self-starter mindset

**Benefits

**Attractive salary is essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact MadhuraPangarkjar], Senior Talent Acquisition Partner at madhura.pangarkar@simcorp.com If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide bеst-іn-clаss solutions to our clients.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us as an Offshore Siting Engineer and immerse yourself in the exciting world of renewable energy! In this role, you will deliver robust site-specific assessments and optimized wind farm concepts for offshore projects during the sales and project development phases. Imagine assessing and characterizing the offshore wind climate, developing and optimizing wind farm layouts, and performing detailed Annual Energy Production assessments. Collaborating closely with diverse teams, you will provide clear recommendations and identify technical risks while contributing to innovative solutions that support our mission for a sustainable future.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• 
Assess and characterize the offshore wind climate, including long-term wind conditions and other site-specific factors relevant to wind farm design.

• 
Develop, evaluate, and optimize offshore wind farm layouts, balancing energy yield and technical constraints.

• 
Perform detailed Annual Energy Production assessments and site suitability assessments using various calculation models and critically evaluate results.

• 
Compare and interpret results from different engineering models to provide clear recommendations to project teams and customers.

• 
Collaborate with colleagues in Technical Sales, Loads, Turbine Engineering, and Product Management to define competitive offshore wind solutions.

What You Bring

• 
A Sc. (preferably M.Sc.) in Engineering or a related field, coupled with strong business acumen.

• 
Several years of experience in the Wind Turbine industry, ideally in R&D, project management, siting, or sales.

• 
A solid understanding of the offshore environment related to siting tasks of large offshore wind farm projects.

• 
Experience with commercially used siting tools such as Windpro and Openwind, along with a flair for learning internal tools.

• 
Fluency in English, both orally and in writing, thriving in multinational environments.

About the Team

Become part of the Siting & Warranties team within the Technical Sales department, which hosts 13 different nationalities and office hubs across Europe and Asia. This team emphasizes camaraderie and teamwork, ensuring that support is always available when needed. As a Siting Engineer, you will collaborate with some of the offshore wind industry’s leading experts, working together to find innovative solutions that drive the renewable energy transition.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Opportunities to work with a global team

• 
Medical benefits

Subsidised lunch and more

A Snapshot of Your Day

We are looking for a highly expert Customer Solution Architect to join our Control and Digitalization team, based at one of our offices around Europe. Working closely with the Head of Digitalization, you will craft and complete projects for Siemens Energy's automation, control systems and digital solutions. On the technical side of our customer solutions, you take products from our portfolio and put them together into a solution that solves the customer's problem, working with customers and their technical departments. The role requires sales, tendering support and project management skills with proven team-working experience in a matrix organization.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Conceptual design and engineering of customer solutions for potential projects, including network and system architecture design and administration

• Designing, developing, factory acceptance testing and on-site commissioning of hardware and software solutions using Omnivise T3000, WinCC, SCADA solutions, Hybrid Plant Controller and other Siemens Energy automation and digital platforms

• Working with product teams to ensure the customer solution is feasible, defining requirements and scopes, and providing feedback for product development

• Providing technical recommendations and decisions to Siemens Energy and to customers based on a clear understanding of the customers' business and operational environment, and ensuring open, regular and effective communication with stakeholders

• Assisting Sales and Bid Managers technically in tender preparation for conventional and innovative application fields such as hybrid plants, substations, district heating, batteries, Power2X, wind and fleet management

• Estimating project influences and risks and evaluating them technically, and proactively promoting innovation, improvements, risk identification and safety management

What You Bring

• Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience, where real-world experience carries a lot of weight

• Solid architecture experience in combining multiple systems into one solution, preferably from a networking perspective, with SCADA or DCS in industrial applications

• Extensive experience in design and commissioning of large-scale industrial automation, ideally from power generation (conventional or renewable), the wider energy industry or industrial and process automation

• A cooperative mindset and the ability to communicate with very different stakeholders, from customers to sales, development and execution

• Willingness to travel within the Europe and Africa region

• Experience with automation products such as Omnivise T3000, WinCC and other SCADA and digitalization solutions for an OT environment is considered an advantage

• Experience from a customer-facing role, for example in execution, sales support or sales, and a project or bid background is considered an advantage

• IT knowledge such as APIs, cloud architectures and virtual environments, and knowledge of IEC 62443, IEC 61850 and IEC 60870, is considered an advantage

About the Team

Our Control and Digitalization team is growing, and we are looking for someone whose technical background complements the skills already in the team, for example within IT, OT protocols, SCADA configuration or networks. It is a very cooperative environment where nobody works alone, and the team already brings strong cyber security expertise. Team members are based in different countries across Europe.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

jobs.occupation: Head of Security Incident Response and Threat Management
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**Join our Security Incident Response and Threat Management Team and take the lead in protecting Danske Bank's critical services across the Nordic region. You will guide a technically strong team through complex threat landscapes while ensuring our customers receive secure, resilient banking services. This role offers the opportunity to shape incident response capabilities in a rapidly evolving digital environment.

**What You Will Be Doing

**As our Security Incident Response Leader, you will lead a team that safeguards banking operations for millions of customers while adapting to cloud and advanced technologies. You will collaborate with technology, business, and risk stakeholders to maintain robust security across the Group.

• Lead and develop a technically skilled incident response and threat management team

• Play a central role in major incident management, leading investigations and making decisions in line with policy, legal requirements and tested processes

• Provide timely briefings to the Chief Security Officer on the status of technical controls, response capabilities and major investigations within your area

• Design and refine incident response processes, runbooks, and playbooks

• Oversee digital forensics to ensure investigations are legally defensible

• Support compliance activities including regulatory requests and audits

• Monitor key performance indicators for detection and containment times

• Foster team growth through mentoring and knowledge sharing

• Coordinate threat intelligence to support tactical and strategic functions

**About You

**

• Minimum 6 years professional experience in cyber security operations

• At least 4 years in daily threat monitoring and response activities

• Minimum 2 years people management or team leadership experience

• Strong understanding of enterprise technologies and security controls

• Ability to communicate clearly with technical and senior stakeholders

• Knowledge of IT risks, controls, and European financial regulations

• Industry certifications such as CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, OSCP, or equivalent

• Experience in financial services or regulated environments would be valuable, along with a master's degree in cyber security, computer science, or related field.

**What We Offer You

**This position can be located both in Lithuania and Denmark. If the position is located in Lithuania the monthly salary range will be from 7040 EUR to 10560 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job).

Additionally, each Danske Bank employee receives employee benefits package (benefits are only valid for Lithuania the same as the salary ranges) which includes:

• Growth opportunities: professional & supportive team, e-learnings, numerous development programs; (incl. professional certificates); 100+ professions for internal mobility opportunities.

• Health & Well-being: a diverse, inclusive, work & life balance work environment; additional health insurance; mental well-being practices; partial psychologist counselling compensation; silence and sleep zones at the office; game rooms.

• Hybrid working conditions: Work from home up to two days a week; home office budget (after the probation period); modern Danske Campus workplace developed with anthropologist for the best employee experience.

• Additional days of leave: for rest, health, volunteering, exams in higher education institutions, and other important activities. Moreover, for seniority with Danske Bank.

• Monetary compensation package: accidents & critical diseases insurance; financial support in case of unfortunate events, travel insurance; IIIrd Pillar Pension Fund contribution.

See all the benefits in Lithuania HERE**.

**Your job function (position) in the job contract will be Cyber Security.

We provide a collaborative environment where you can develop cutting-edge security capabilities while leading a talented team. You will work in a hybrid model with 3 to 4 days per week in the office to promote knowledge sharing and team collaboration. We support your professional growth through continuous learning opportunities and career progression within our expanding security function.

If you're interested in this role and joining my team, feel free to contact me - Cliff Kamara via LinkedIn**.** I will be happy to answer your questions.

**About Us

**Danske Bank is a Nordic bank with bridges to the world around us. For 150 years, we have supported people and businesses in releasing their potential. A career with us is an opportunity to join a community of 22,000 colleagues in a culture where we are committed to Teaming Up, Owning It and Being Open. Together, we are on a journey to transform Danske Bank into a better bank. For our customers, our employees and the societies around us.

SmallClaims is a legal tech company that recovers small, valid claims of up to €25,000 through the courts. Claims that businesses write off today because pursuing them costs more than they are worth. Our AI agents run the whole process, from legal assessment and settlement to filing, judgment and enforcement, while our in-house lawyers quality-assure the work and appear in court. That has cut manual case handling from over 15 hours to about 1.5 hours per case. We have handled 5,000+ cases, win 90%+ in court and serve 500+ Danish customers. Case intake has grown more than 370% since 2023, and we have just raised €2M from Vendep Capital to grow in Europe. Now we are growing the engineering team.

**THE ROLE

**You take ownership of your own areas within our AI service (Python/FastAPI, LLM pipelines) and our back-office platform, the tool our case managers and lawyers run the operation on. Ideas take form together with the team, product specialists and the CTO. You take them from there, end to end across the stack: shape, build, ship, verify, follow up.

**What You’ll Work On

**

• Own parts of and build features in our AI service: LLM orchestration with structured outputs, tool calling, and complex agentic workflows.

• Build the back-office platform our case managers and lawyers use every day, and talk to them to find out what they really need.

• Set up and improve evals and observability, so we know our agents are right before we scale them.

• Ship and run what you build, from staging to production on AWS, with tests and CI as a habit.

**What We Work With

**

• Stack: Laravel/PHP, Next.js, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, Google.

• How we build: Coding agents are part of daily work here. We expect you to be ahead of the curve on building with AI, not catching up to it.

**Who You Are

**

• 3+ years building and operating software in production, from a startup, a bigger company, open source or other serious project.

• You think like a product owner. You want responsibility and ownership, and you take a complicated problem to a shipped feature.

• You are good with data: you understand complex data sets and data pipelines, and you can build with them, visualise them and explain them.

• You hold strong opinions lightly. You are direct in disagreement, but easy to work with after the decision.

• You communicate directly and are honest about mistakes. You can talk to real users and are comfortable with shifting priorities.

• You love building, love learning, and are curious about the domain itself: the legal process, not just the tech.

**Experience And Skills

****Must have

**

• Strong backend development, incl. background jobs, auth models and API design.

• Solid relational database experience (Postgres/SQL or similar): schema design, migrations, performance.

• Hands-on LLM building in production, not just demos: orchestration, structured outputs, tool calling, evals, tracing, prompt design, injection.

• Works daily with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode or similar), knows their strengths and limits, and stays up to date.

• Testing as a habit: feature and end-to-end tests, CI, verifying your own work through staging to production.

• Cloud and deployment literacy (AWS or similar, Docker, CI/CD). You can operate what you ship.

**Nice to have

**

• Python/FastAPI, Laravel/PHP or Next.js specifically.

• Production migration: third-party service changes, database moves, major-version upgrades, data backfills.

• Operating AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and Linux servers hands-on.

• Eval or observability tooling for agentic workflows.

• Integrations where no documented API exists: webhooks, browser extensions, automation, scraping.

• Legaltech, fintech or another regulated domain.

**What We Offer

**

• Real ownership of core parts of the AI platform in a small team that ships every week.

• Close work with the CTO, product specialists and the lawyers who use what you build.

• Our base is the office in Copenhagen, but regular remote work is fine

**How To Apply

**Apply via The Hub with a short intro, your CV, GitHub and links to things you have built: apps, side projects, something you shipped at work. Next, we send you our skills checklist as a self-assessment plus a few short written questions, then interviews with the team, then an offer. We keep the process short and give you a clear answer at every step.

Join us in this role where you’ll manage key insurance activities across the organisation, respond to changing risk exposures, and help ensure appropriate coverage in line with our insurance policy. You’ll coordinate day-to-day delivery, renewals, tenders, and projects while working closely with colleagues, insurers, and brokers.

**Welcome to Group Risk:

**You’ll be part of Insurance where you, together with your colleagues, will support business units, companies, and regions and manage insurance for the organisation’s global risks. The team consists of seven specialists, primarily based in Gentofte, with two colleagues in London. As a team, we share expertise, take responsibility, and help each other deliver high-quality solutions.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• managing local Danish insurance arrangements, including motor, workers’ compensation, and accident insurance

• coordinating global employee-related insurance programmes for international assignments and business travel

• handling daily enquiries, annual renewals, and relevant tender activities with internal and external stakeholders

• supporting insurance activities for power generation, pipeline, and storage operations, including communication with the business

• coordinating insurance-related technology tasks and contributing to the implementation and continuous improvement of the insurance management system

• leading or contributing to projects in the Insurance team, preparing documents and presentations, and maintaining effective administrative controls.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have an experience with corporate insurance, insurance broking, or a related risk and insurance role

• understand employee-related insurance programmes and have experience with, or a strong interest in, property insurance

• can manage renewals, tenders, enquiries, documentation, and multiple stakeholders with attention to quality and detail

• communicate clearly and confidently in written and spoken English in an international working environment

• feel comfortable using Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, and can work with business systems such as SAP and SharePoint

• work independently, collaborate openly, take initiative, and stay effective in a changing environment.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr45,000.00- kr65,000.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

We are seeking a strategic and solutions-oriented Director, Creative Operations to lead the operational backbone of our in-house creative team. As a key leader within the organization, you will be responsible for driving efficiency, optimizing workflows, and enabling the seamless delivery of creative work for a global audience.

This role will lead project management, creative operations systems, technology enablement, and external agency partnerships to ensure our teams deliver best-in-class creative work at scale. You will collaborate closely with Digital & Technology, Brand, Marketing, and Production teams to shape and evolve the creative operating model, lead technology initiatives, and identify opportunities to improve speed, quality, and efficiency through automation and emerging technologies.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized and collaborative leader with deep expertise in creative operations, workflow transformation, technology implementation, and change management. You are equally comfortable developing long-term operational strategies and ensuring day-to-day execution excellence.

Creative Operations & Project Management

• 
Lead the Creative Studio operating model, including intake, prioritization, capacity planning, resource allocation, and project delivery.

Drive continuous improvement of creative workflows, systems, and governance across project management, DAM, and MRM platforms.

Agency & Vendor Management

Change Management & Transformation

•

• 
Drive continuous improvement and build organizational capability in creative operations, technology adoption, and operational excellence.

Budget & Resource Management

•

• 
Partner with Finance and Production to monitor spend, measure ROI, and drive efficiency across people, processes, and technology.

Qualifications & Experience

Significant experience in Creative Operations, Project Management, Marketing Operations, or workflow transformation within an in-house agency, creative organization, or related environment.

• 
Experience leading or shaping creative operations functions, operating models, or large-scale transformation initiatives.

• 
Expertise in enterprise project management, DAM, MRM, workflow management, and collaboration platforms (e.g., Workfront, Asana, Wrike, Bynder, Aprimo, or similar).

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Creative Operations at Pandora. jobs.occupation: Group Vice President, Portfolio Strategy, Insights & Access
jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**As GVP, Portfolio Strategy, Insights & Access, you will lead the team that shapes where Novo invests across its portfolio. You will turn market, customer, competitor and access insights into clear recommendations for Executive Management, guiding choices on pipeline, lifecycle management, launches and business development. Working from Denmark with a global scope, you will make sure every portfolio decision balances patient impact, access feasibility and financial value, so the right treatments reach the people who need them.

**What You’ll Bring

**This is a senior leadership role for someone who combines strategic depth with the confidence to guide decisions at the highest level. You will bring:

• An advanced degree, such as an MBA, MSc, PhD, PharmD or MD, or a degree in Economics, Public Health or an equivalent field.

• 15–20+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, pharmaceuticals, market access, forecasting, commercial excellence or portfolio management.

• Experience presenting to executive leadership and governance boards, with strong executive-ready storytelling for decision forums.

• Proven people leadership and stakeholder management experience, including leading large, diverse, cross-functional teams.

• Strong strategic, commercial and analytical capabilities – you are data-driven and able to make decisions under uncertainty.

• A proven ability to balance patient impact, access considerations and financial outcomes.

• The confidence to challenge and influence C-suite and SVP-level stakeholders.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**Experience developing innovative payment models or working with access partners, such as telehealth providers.

**What You’ll Do

**You will lead the strategic engine behind Novo’s portfolio decisions – connecting strategy, evidence, forecasting and access into recommendations that senior leaders can act on.

• Define and drive long-term portfolio strategies across therapy areas, assessing pipeline, lifecycle management and business development opportunities.

• Lead strategic evaluations of portfolio investments and prioritisation and bring clear recommendations to Executive Management and governance committees, such as the Portfolio Committee.

• Translate market, customer (healthcare professionals, patients and consumers), competitor and healthcare system insights into actionable direction, supported by ongoing competitive intelligence and horizon scanning.

• Shape long-range forecast assumptions, scenario planning and business cases for pipeline assets, launches and strategic investments to support resource allocation.

• Integrate payer, reimbursement and health technology assessment (HTA) considerations into portfolio decisions and make sure access strategies are reflected in development and commercialisation plans.

• Raise the quality and speed of decision support by improving scenario planning methods, competitive assessment approaches and shared decision frameworks.

• Provide strategic leadership across NPP, Early Pipeline & Exploratory, helping shape the future portfolio and translate early opportunities into clear strategic choices. You will work closely with R&D and other key functions to bring patient, market and commercial perspectives into early asset and indication strategies, while driving senior-level alignment on portfolio priorities and investment decisions.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will lead Portfolio Strategy, Insights & Access, a team of around 140 colleagues, through four direct reports, and report to the Executive Vice President of Product & Portfolio Strategy. In Product & Portfolio Strategy, colleagues connect commercial strategy, medical affairs and business development across therapy areas, helping guide the Novo portfolio and strengthen competitiveness.

You will partner with Executive Management and governance committees, Commercial, Medical, Development, Finance and Operations leadership, global and affiliate Market Access teams, and Corporate Strategy, Business Development and Portfolio Management. You will also work with regional leadership teams to align assumptions, access strategy and launch planning.

Externally, you will engage health economics and market access advisors, HTA bodies, payers and insurers, industry consortia, academic experts and channel partners. Across all these relationships, your role is to create clarity, build alignment without direct authority and keep decisions moving at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will hold a position where your voice directly shapes decisions on investment, prioritisation and commercialisation across therapy areas. You will be trusted to own the recommendations you bring, to challenge with honest, evidence-based perspectives and, once a decision is made, to commit and move forward together.

You will lead a large, multidisciplinary organisation and build new skills through work that spans the value chain – from development and access to launch and lifecycle management. You will help set the standard for strategic analytics, forecasting and business case development across Novo.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead the decisions that shape Novo’s portfolio and help more people live healthier lives, apply for the GVP, Portfolio Strategy, Insights & Access role by **28 October 2026

jobs.occupation: Program Manager - HR Shared Services Center, Global HR
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and driven Program Manager to lead the establishment of HR Shared Services Center (SSC), a key pillar in our HR transformation journey, driving the design, planning, and implementation of this strategic initiative.

In this role, you will establish a program organization and lead multiple workstreams and coordinate timelines, resources, budgets, stakeholders and risks to ensure the successful implementation of our HR Shared Services Center. You know which priorities to recommend, what to communicate to the HR organization and when to involve other corporate functions if necessary. Furthermore, you will bring together people, processes, technology and organisational change to establish an efficient, scalable and high-quality HR service delivery model.

Welcome to Global HR

You will join Demant's Global HR organization and work closely with HR Core Deliveries, business units, Shared Services C operations teams and stakeholders across the global organization.

Our approximately 400 HR professionals work globally to attract, develop and empower the people who drive Demant's continued success. As a global leader in hearing healthcare and hearing aid technology, Demant is on an ambitious transformation journey. In this role, you will help shape how HR services are delivered and experienced across the organization.

Lead the HR Shared Services Center Transition

As Program Manager for HR SSC, you will manage the day-to-day implementation of the SSC transition, coordinating multiple workstreams and ensuring alignment throughout the implementation. Working closely with senior leadership, HR Core Deliveries, business units, SSC operations and project leads, you will maintain momentum, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure clear communication and decision-making. You will also help ensure business continuity and successful adoption of the new HR service delivery model.

In this role, you will:

• 
Lead program delivery, including plans, milestones, budgets, KPIs, governance and coordination of multiple workstreams.

• 
Be responsible for the business case

• 
Track project progress against established milestones, KPIs and business case

• 
Drive stakeholder alignment and communication, facilitating collaboration across senior leadership, HR, business units and SSC operations.

• 
Manage resources, risks and dependencies, ensuring appropriate allocation of capacity and timely escalation and resolution of issues.

• 
Oversee transition and change activities, supporting adoption and maintaining business continuity throughout implementation.

• 
Ensure effective reporting and project governance, including dashboards, steering committee materials, decisions, actions and lessons learned.

• 
Ensure quality and compliance, including appropriate acceptance criteria and consideration of country-specific legal and regulatory requirements.

What You Bring

You hold a bachelor's or master’s degree in business administration, Human Resources, Project Management, Organizational Development or a related field.

You have significant project management/program management experience, including large-scale transformation or Shared Services Center establishment and transition initiatives. You have successfully managed complex, multi-workstream projects involving substantial budgets and diverse stakeholders, preferably within HR operations or HR transformation.

You have great knowledge of project management methodologies and tools. PMP certification or equivalent is an advantage, as is experience with platforms such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Asana or similar.

Experience with HR systems and processes is important, with knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow or similar solutions considered an advantage. You are also highly proficient in Microsoft Office and comfortable working with project dashboards, reporting and data. As a colleague, you are structured, collaborative and solution oriented. You create clarity and momentum in complex environments and can lead cross-functional teams without direct authority. You communicate assertively with both project teams and senior executives and are comfortable working across cultures and geographies.

Furthermore, you are analytical and pragmatic, with good problem-solving and stakeholder management skills. You combine project management discipline with business acumen and an understanding of HR operations and organisational dynamics.

Finally, you have a good compliance mindset and understand the importance of balancing country-specific requirements with global standards and objectives.

Come and join us

This is an opportunity to take a central role in a significant HR transformation and help shape the future delivery of HR services across Demant.

You will work with experienced colleagues and senior stakeholders across the global organization and have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on how HR services are delivered, scaled and continuously improved.

If you enjoy complex transformations, international collaboration and turning ambitious plans into successful execution, we would like to hear from you.

Come and join us

Send your CV before application deadline November 2.

For inquiries regarding the application process, please use the online application form.

If you would like to know more about the position, you are welcome to contact Vice President, Global HR Core Deliveries, Maj Øhle Storri, via email mjsr_@demant.com_

We are curious to meet you.

Recruitment Process Information

We will begin inviting candidates for interviews after the application deadline. First round of interviews are scheduled for the 9th, 10th, and 11th of November. You can expect the final round interviews to be held on the 17th, and 18th of November.

About Demant

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health, and innovation since 1904. The Group offers innovative technologies, solutions, and expertise to help people hear better. In every aspect, from hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment and services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged. Headquartered in Denmark, the Group employs more than 21,000 people globally and is present with solutions in 130 countries where we create life-changing hearing health and high-end audio and video solutions. William Demant Foundation holds the majority of shares in Demant A/S, which is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and among the 25 most traded stocks.

jobs.occupation: Test Method Specialist, Quality Assurance Lifecycle Laboratory
jobs.description:
Imagine if robust test methods and reliable test equipment helped ensure the quality of both new and existing Coloplast products. That is where you come in.

As our new Test Method Specialist, you will become the technical focal point for selected test methods and related equipment in Coloplast Mørdrup, primarily supporting the QA Lifecycle Laboratory and Pilot SVS. This is a practical, hands-on specialist role in which you will work directly with laboratory equipment, including troubleshooting, service and calibration follow-up, qualification, and software and computer upgrades. You will support the full test method and equipment lifecycle, from implementation and qualification to maintenance, transfer and continuous improvement.

If you are motivated by hands-on technical problem-solving, equipment responsibility, quality assurance and data evaluation, this role offers meaningful responsibility and broad organisational impact. You will also work closely with many internal and external stakeholders, making clear communication, coordination and strong stakeholder management an important part of your success.

“In this role, your technical judgement and ability to create robust solutions will help ensure reliable test results and compliant laboratory processes throughout the product lifecycle,” says Lotte Stoklund, Team Manager, QA Lifecycle Laboratory.

Join a skilled and collaborative laboratory team

At our Coloplast Mørdrup site, you will join the Quality Assurance Lifecycle Laboratory. The team consists of laboratory technicians and test method specialists who work closely together to support ongoing production, process development, quality investigations and test method activities.

You will be part of an engaged team with a strong mix of practical laboratory experience and specialist knowledge. In our daily work, we collaborate closely with colleagues across Quality Assurance, Research and Development, Operations, Global Test Method teams and international manufacturing sites. We value curiosity, knowledge sharing, flexibility and a continuous improvement mindset.

Own and develop test methods and equipment

As Test Method Specialist, you will act as a one-point contact and technical superuser for selected test methods and test equipment. A significant part of the role is practical equipment responsibility. You will work hands-on with equipment and coordinate activities to ensure it is qualified, calibrated, serviced, maintained and performing as intended. You will also support software and computer upgrades connected to the equipment, as well as reliable data handling and traceability.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

•    Acting as technical owner and one-point contact for selected test methods and related test equipment

•    Planning, coordinating and performing qualification of test equipment, including relocation, capacity expansion and replacement of critical parts

•    Preparing and maintaining qualification protocols, reports, procedures, test method documentation and one-point lessons when needed

•    Performing hands-on troubleshooting of test equipment and methods, evaluating test results and leading root cause investigations when failures occur

•    Taking practical responsibility for test equipment, including service activities, calibration follow-up, preventive maintenance and ensuring that equipment performs as intended

•    Handling changes, nonconformities and CAPAs related to test methods, calibration and test equipment

•    Supporting compliant storage and traceability of raw data before product release

•    Planning and participating in transfers of test methods and equipment to international manufacturing sites

•    Providing technical support and sparring to colleagues in the Pilot Plant, Global Operations and international manufacturing sites

•    Collaborating with Global Test Method teams and contributing technical input to the development and improvement of test methods

•    Training specialists, laboratory technicians, operators and other users in test methods, test principles and use of equipment

•    Coordinating software and computer upgrades for test equipment, assessing their impact on qualification and documentation, and managing suppliers, service visits and relevant service agreements

•    Participating in internal and external audits related to test methods, equipment and documentation

•    Contributing to continuous improvement of laboratory processes, systems and ways of working

Bring strong technical judgement and a quality mindset

To succeed in this position, you combine technical depth with a structured, practical and hands-on approach. You enjoy working directly with equipment, take ownership and work systematically when resolving technical issues. You are comfortable making decisions based on data, risk and regulatory requirements.

The role involves close collaboration with many internal and external stakeholders, therefor you communicate clearly, coordinate effectively and are able to build strong working relationships across functions, sites and suppliers.

We imagine that you bring:

•   A master’s degree within science, engineering, mechanics, physics, chemistry, pharmacy or a comparable technical field, or have at least five years of relevant experience with test methods

•   Solid hands-on experience with test methods, measurement principles and qualification of laboratory or production test equipment

•   Strong problem-solving skills and experience with structured root cause analysis

•   Confident evaluating, analysing and presenting technical data skills, including the use of statistical methods

•   Ability to write, review and understand technical documentation, protocols and reports

•   Knowledge of quality systems and regulated environments; knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 13485 and GMP is an advantage

•   An understanding of validation, calibration, design control, specifications and process risk management

•   Abitlity to plan and prioritise your work effectively and follow activities through to completion

•   Strong stakeholder management skills and collaborate effectively across disciplines, functions, geographical locations and external suppliers

•    Communicating skills professionally in English, both written and spoken; Danish is an advantage

•    A comfortable competence using digital tools for documentation, data analysis and traceability; experience with Microsoft Office, Veeva, JMP or similar systems is an advantage

A specialist role with broad impact

This is a permanent specialist position in the QA Lifecycle Laboratory. The role has no direct reports and includes collaboration with international colleagues and manufacturing sites. Some travel may be expected in connection with transfers, supplier activities and site support.

You will join a working environment where quality, safety, technical excellence, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are central to our daily work. You will have the opportunity to build a broad network and influence how test methods and equipment are managed across the product lifecycle.

Interested?

At Demant, we are united by a shared purpose: creating life-changing hearing health. You will work closely with colleagues across infrastructure, applications, and business functions to ensure that critical services remain available, operational, resilient, and continuously improving.

Your responsibilities

As IT Process & Delivery Manager, you will:

• Drive continuous improvements of Incident, Major Incident, and Problem Management processes.

• Lead the coordination of major incidents to minimize business impact and restore services as quickly and effectively as possible.

• Facilitate technical investigations, bridge calls, root cause analyses, and post-incident reviews.

• Partner with technical teams and business stakeholders to translate complex technical issues into clear communication and actionable plans.

• Ensure improvement initiatives are followed through and delivered with measurable outcomes.

• Establish and promote proactive operational practices by identifying recurring issues and potential risks before they impact on our business.

• Support the development of governance practices and reporting for business-critical services.

• Build strong collaborative relationships across IT teams and business functions.

**

• Experience coordinating major incidents, operational improvements, service management activities, or larger cross-functional initiatives.

• The ability to facilitate discussions between technical specialists and business stakeholders.

• The confidence to challenge existing processes constructively and contribute new ideas.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence how business-critical IT services are managed and developed while working closely with experienced specialists and stakeholders across the organization.

You will play an important role in strengthening operational excellence and business resilience through meaningful improvements that have a direct impact on the business. Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health and innovation since 1904.
